loreJson.text: A compact switch whittled from dense acacia, yielding a crisp click and a fleeting pulse when pressed.
A balanced wooden treadle, ready to spring beneath the lightest step and awaken concealed mechanisms.
A specialised track fitted with a redstone charge, tripping mechanisms within passing minecarts at full speed.
A tidy switch carved from pale bamboo, springing back quickly under a fingertip.
A springy bamboo treadle that yields easily underfoot, tripping hidden lines with minimal force.
A small switch turned from pale birch heartwood, blending seamlessly into light-colored walls and paneling.
A pale wooden treadle that rests flush with light flagstones, silently catching the weight of unwary boots.
A sculk sensor attuned with pure amethyst, able to filter out chaotic noise and listen only for chosen acoustic frequencies.
A charming switch whittled from pink cherry heartwood, clicking softly within blossom-paneled rooms.
A springy pink wooden plate resting level with the floor, silently activating mechanisms beneath falling petals.
A wooden chest bolted securely into an iron cart, rumbling along the rails to haul deep-mine wealth back to the surface.
A delicate logic gate fitted with quartz crystals, comparing incoming currents and measuring the fullness of chests.
A toggleable lamp encased in copper, flicking on and off with redstone pulses, dimming its glow as oxidation coats the shell.
An ingenious automaton workbench that reads redstone pulses, snapping arranged components together into finished goods.
A crimson fungus switch with tough fibrous grain, entirely impervious to the licking flames of the Nether.
A fireproof scarlet treadle resting flush with the floor, tripping hidden redstone paths amidst burning landscapes.
A dark, close-grained wooden switch that blends into paneled walls and responds with a muted click.
A dark wooden treadle that rests unobtrusively upon shaded floors, springing beneath the step to trigger hidden lines.
A polished quartz sensor resting over redstone circuitry, breathing changing signal strength with the rise and fall of the sun.
A rail segment fitted with a heavy pressure plate, announcing the passage of minecarts with an immediate signal pulse.
A mechanical stone trap housing a tensioned bowstring, snapping arrows, potions, and charges aloft on command.
A stone mechanism fitted with an ejector slit, spitting single items into the world or adjacent hoppers on each pulse.
A copper lamp bearing faint tarnish across its housing, casting a slightly softer glow with each redstone pulse.
A cast-iron cart carrying an active stone furnace, chugging along the rails to push heavy convoys through dark mine shafts.
A heavy-gauge iron treadle tuned to broad weight, ignoring stray pebbles to signal only upon massive accumulations or heavy treads.
A thick, translucent block of solidified golden nectar, delightfully sticky enough to arrest falls and drag adjacent masonry along with it.
A funnel-necked iron sorting hopper, gathering loose supplies from above and feeding them steadily into connected chests or furnaces.
An iron minecart fitted with a wide gathering funnel, vacuuming up loose ores and field drops through the rails as it travels.
A warm, red-brown switch whittled from jungle wood, springing smoothly beneath a finger to trip hidden lines.
A reddish wooden treadle resting flush with jungle floorboards, catching the tread of intruders to trigger hidden defenses.
A short handle pivots on stone and holds the selected switch position.
A thin gold plate responds to a light load and strengthens its signal as items accumulate.
A long copper rod narrows to a point and draws lightning toward a chosen elevated position.
A dark red switch whittled from dense mangrove heartwood, springing smoothly beneath a finger to trip hidden lines.
A dark red wooden treadle resting flush with swamp boardwalks, reliably tripping redstone lines even under humid conditions.
A sturdy iron tub mounted on smooth flanged wheels, rolling along the rails to carry miners and heavy freight through the deeps.
A hollow wooden box resonates differently according to the material beneath it.
A small switch turned from pale oak heartwood, clicking with honest warmth beneath a finger to trip hidden lines.
A smooth oak treadle resting flush with floorboards, springing beneath the tread to trigger hidden redstone mechanisms.
Openings mark one side of the stone casing, sending a brief signal from the back when the front changes.
A fully oxidized copper lamp shrouded in verdigris, emitting a dim, moody light on redstone pulses like a forgotten beacon.
A mechanical stone-and-timber piston driven by iron linkage, extending with sudden hydraulic force to shove heavy blocks aside.
A discreet switch turned from polished volcanic glass, clicking with dark authority to trigger hidden redstone paths.
A dark stone treadle resting flush with blackstone flagstones, silently activating defenses beneath unwary feet.
Gold-plated rails laced with redstone circuitry, blazing with kinetic energy when powered to propel passing minecarts at furious speed.
Iron bars securely spiked across wooden ties, guiding rolling minecarts smoothly across vast plains and twisting mine shafts.
Fine crimson dust harvested from deep strata, humming with dormant energy to carry current, trip traps, and breathe life into great machines.
A solid block of compressed redstone dust, radiating a permanent, unquenchable current to empower adjacent mechanisms indefinitely.
A glowstone core framed in timber and laced with redstone, blazing into clean, steady sunlight the moment a current wakes its circuits.
A slender stick tipped with smouldering redstone dust, casting a dim, moody light while providing an unyielding current to nearby lines.
A stone slab mounting dual redstone torches and a sliding diode, boosting faint currents and pacing signal delay with clockwork precision.
Tendrilled organic node attuning its dark fronds to the air, translating every footstep, splash, and arrow into an acoustic shockwave.
A massive, translucent block of solidified slime, so violently springy that it absorbs terrifying falls and launches travelers skyward.
A discreet wooden switch turned from dense spruce timber, clicking smoothly within dark-paneled log cabins.
A dark wooden treadle resting flush with spruce floorboards, reliably tripping redstone lines beneath the tread of intruders.
Green slime coats the piston face so it can pull a block back after extending.
A discrete switch ground from natural stone, blending seamlessly into rock walls and responding with a firm, solid click.
A solid stone treadle resting flush with flagstones, ignoring falling items to trip hidden mechanisms only beneath the step of living beings.
A straw-woven target face packed with redstone, translating the precision of an incoming arrow into proportional signal strength.
Packed gunpowder stabilized with dry sand, sleeping quietly until ignited by spark or current to unleash a landscape-shattering blast.
An iron minecart rigged with a primed explosive charge, detonating violently upon high-speed impact or crossing activator rails.
A small mechanism joins the chest latch, alerting a neighbouring circuit as the lid opens.
An iron catch anchored to a wooden block, holding taut strings across dungeon corridors to spring concealed traps beneath unwary steps.
A cyan wooden switch whittled from dense warped heartwood, entirely impervious to fire and clicking softly within exotic walls.
A fireproof cyan wooden treadle resting flush with the floor, tripping hidden redstone lines amidst burning landscapes.
A copper lamp sealed in wax to prevent tarnish, delivering its maximum, pristine brilliance on every redstone pulse indefinitely.
A lightly weathered copper lamp sealed with wax, preserving its soft, comfortable level of illumination for all time.
A fully patinated copper lamp sealed with wax, emitting a permanent, moody twilight glow on redstone pulses like an immortal relic.
A heavily weathered copper lamp sealed with beeswax, maintaining its soft, atmospheric level of illumination indefinitely.
A heavily weathered copper lamp shrouded in tarnish, casting a muted, ambient glow on each redstone pulse.
